title: Twofold
summary: TWOFOLD, adjective [two and fold.] Two of the same kind, or two different things existing together; as twofold nature; a twofold sense; a twofold argument. 1. Double; as twofold strength or desire. 2.

inlines.v: TWOFOLD, adjective [two and fold.] Two of the same kind, or two different things existing together; as twofold nature; a twofold sense; a twofold argument. 1. Double; as twofold strength or desire. 2. In botany, two and two together, growing form the same place; as twofold leaves. TWOFOLD, adverb Doubly; in a double degree. Matthew 23:15.
